title: Designing Biomedical Artificial Intelligence Experiments
audience: Clinical learners designing AI experiments for readmission risk and discharge planning
objectives: Identify knowledge gaps in clinical AI readmission prediction.
Turn clinical problems into SMART research questions.
Plan data selection, preprocessing, splitting, modeling, and evaluation.
Address concept drift, transparency, fairness, prospective readiness, ethics, and communication.

sections.name: Knowledge Gaps and Research Questions
sections.purpose: Frame a clinically meaningful AI experiment.
sections.how_to_use: Write three gaps in current readmission prediction work, then define primary and secondary SMART research questions.

sections.name: Data Management Strategy
sections.purpose: Plan clinical data elements, preprocessing, temporal handling, and split strategy.
sections.how_to_use: Select MIMIC-IV data elements, specify inclusion and exclusion criteria, handle missing data, and plan bias mitigation.

sections.name: Experimental Design
sections.purpose: Choose models and metrics beyond accuracy.
sections.how_to_use: Describe candidate algorithms, pick a main model, justify metrics, and explain clinical relevance.

sections.name: Addressing Challenges
sections.purpose: Prepare the model for clinical reality.
sections.how_to_use: Explain how to handle concept drift, transparency, fairness across populations, and prospective evaluation readiness.

sections.name: Ethics and Reflection
sections.purpose: Connect experiment design to responsible clinical use.
sections.how_to_use: Address privacy, consent, security, fairness, clinical accountability, incidental findings, limitations, and communication.

chatbot_guidance: When asked how to use this notebook, guide the learner from clinical problem framing to data plan, model plan, evaluation, ethics, and communication.
For clinical users, emphasize patient safety, temporal leakage, missing data, clinical relevance, fairness, and prospective validation.
Help learners make answers specific to CHF readmission risk and discharge planning.
